protocol.estimator: existing pinned WindowGraph; no source modifications
protocol.case_scope: static antenna-frame reduction, not dynamic body-frame calibration
protocol.state: antenna XY plus auxiliary yaw; fixed historical antenna heights
protocol.initial: independent per-car four-wall-only first-five-receipt-second bootstrap; no surveyed XY or peer
protocol.timing: VM bag receipt order; integer ns; 1Hz cutoff; trailing 0.8s median; no future input
protocol.weight_definition: multiply original peer pseudo-Huber residual AND Jacobian by sqrt(weight); keep robust scale fixed
protocol.peer: car1-to-car2 only; reverse diagnostic, not a second independent factor
protocol.ranges: parsed bridge canonical once; raw topics not duplicated as additional factors
protocol.phases: normal electronic-start+40:55; human hold_ack+5:25; recovery returned_ack+60:85; P00 normal bag-start+40:55
protocol.score: same run/car/reference/time; common accepted I/J/W025; per-window descriptive, not population MSE
protocol.reference_bound: static shared point: meanD(r) +/- 2*epsilon*norm(mean(c-i)); no epsilon certification
limitations: Receipt time does not establish physical action latency or a calibrated dynamic clock.
Normal operation is not zero-bias certification; both vehicles can be biased.
Engineering graph weights are not calibrated sampling covariance.
Fixed-height installation and anchor uncertainty have not been quantified.
Single static run and correlated keyframes are not independent experimental repetitions.
Single-update theoretical MSE boundary is not an exact theorem for nonlinear fixed-lag outputs.

calibration_profile.scope: previous Car2 calibration transferred conditionally; not a health certificate; Car1 remains uncorrected

epsilon_basis.source: operator report in this conversation after development replay started
epsilon_basis.original_instrument_statement: 用的雷达测距仪手机的 我们这些误差有多少误差这很难知道 不过我是两次核对的 地上也有卷尺量的点位
epsilon_basis.instrument: phone ranging as reported; model/app not specified
epsilon_basis.repeat_checks: operator reports twice checked; individual repeat values not recorded
epsilon_basis.analysis_assumption: conservatively interpret 2cm per XY coordinate, enclosing planar ball radius sqrt(2)*.02m
epsilon_basis.coverage: operator estimate, not independently calibrated hard bound or 95% confidence interval

G2 tests the explicitly conditional mean-bias transfer prediction; changed Car2 geometry can violate constant-bias transfer.

report_policy: all runs/profiles/vehicles/phases, common accepted I/J/W025; no dropping weak/adverse/indeterminate outputs
run9_policy: retain all phases and flag possible recovery occupancy change; recovery excluded from clean-protocol aggregate only, not from the results table
reference_evaluation: nominal RMSE and exact common-static-reference paired squared-error interval; reported estimate, not certified coverage
repair_policy: preserve attempts; any result-informed method change revokes independent use for affected exposed runs
